name: Hoarding
overview: Scripture warns against hoarding and withholding resources from those in need, emphasizing generosity and trust in God's provision. Proverbs instructs believers not to withhold good when it is in their power to help, highlighting that withholding grain brings curses while selling it brings blessings. Jesus teaches that one cannot serve both God and wealth, urging followers to rely on God rather than anxious pursuit of material needs. True profit is not found in worldly gain but in the soul’s salvation, and Christ calls His followers to give generously to the poor as a path to heavenly treasure.
